orca_meta.source: ORCA demo subset - approximate extents of real Indian marine protected areas
orca_meta.licence: Hand-digitised approximate bounding extents for ORCA demonstration only; NOT the official WDPA geometry.
orca_meta.disclaimer: DEMO data. Approximate rectangular extents, not authoritative boundaries. A protected area becomes a HARD routing constraint only when the operator explicitly configures it; the Policy / Safety Guard remains authoritative.
orca_meta.note: Run scripts/ingest_static_gis.py wdpa against the extracted WDPA shapefile to replace this with the real WDPA India geometry (wdpa_india.geojson).
